sub: Agency owners rarely fail because they can't sell. They fail because fulfillment eats the founder. growX takes it off your plate entirely, so you can sell bigger, serve more, and scale without hiring.

cards.title: Capacity, not demand
cards.blurb: You win work faster than you can deliver it. Fulfillment, not sales, is what caps how big you get.
points: Turning away clients you could easily close
Rushed delivery quietly churning the clients you have
No way to scale past your current team's ceiling

cards.title: Freelancer roulette
cards.blurb: Underdelivery, missed deadlines, ghosting. And every freelancer is a crack in your white-label promise.
points: Forever hunting for reliable talent that sticks
Quality and turnaround you can never predict
Hours lost managing a patchwork of contractors

cards.title: A menu you can't fulfill
cards.blurb: Clients ask for SEO, video, funnels, a CRM build. You say no, or scramble to learn it overnight.
points: Leaving upsell revenue on the table
Learning a new skill just to ship one project

cards.title: Margins that leak
cards.blurb: Random vendors and scope creep eat your profit. You can't price with confidence when costs move every week.
points: Unpredictable vendor costs shrinking every job
Scope creep turning profit into loss
No fixed cost base to price against

cards.title: Fulfillment eats the founder
cards.blurb: Sales, delivery, client comms, ops, all on you. Something is about to break, and it is usually you.
points: 80-hour weeks just to keep the lights on
Zero time left to actually grow the business
Burnout from wearing every hat you own
